Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields; their direction will heavily influence your tech positions. Also, watch for any spillover strength from Oracle's positive news into the broader cloud/chip sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your deep losses and respecting scanner signals, especially with margin.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL to cut deep losses and reduce leveraged exposure. Their default stops are no longer relevant.
Consider taking profits on SPY, respecting the SELL signal from your scanner.
